description: The design-source render oracle wiring (exit criterion E7, guardrail G-11). Per frame the oracle imports the committed Figma fixture (corpus/figma-fixtures/<name>.json), compiles it through dashc's compile_figma (Profile::Core), loads and re-solves it with the TaffySolver, renders the committed scene with the Skia reference painter, and diffs that fresh render against the committed Figma design-source PNG (Figma's REST GET /images export) within the frame's per-rule tolerance band. The reference is OUR render of the imported fixture, not a pre-committed corpus golden — so the diff measures the reference painter against Figma's own render of the same scene at the same size. The harness and the bands live in goldens/tooling/src/oracle.rs; the diff runs in goldens/tooling/tests/render_oracle.rs (the_reference_renders_match_their_design_source), un-gated because it is hermetic (committed fixture + committed design source + in-process compile_figma, no network) and fast. A frame is captured by setting its figmaFileKey and figmaNodeId and running `deno task oracle-capture` (importers/figma); that step downloads Figma's GET /images render into design-source/<frame>.png and flips the frame's designSource and status to captured.

gate.reason: Two layout frames (v08-wrap, v08-grid-spans) are measured now: their committed fixtures render through the reference painter and diff within the aa-edge band against a captured Figma GET /images design source. The other five frames stay pending because each needs work that is not this story: v08-baseline's fixture (lowering-baseline.json) carries TEXT, so it needs the glyph-run/typeset render path the oracle render helper does not yet drive; v08-drop-shadow and v08-inner-shadow have no renderable fixture (effects-2025 is a diagnostic REJECT fixture that emits no document) and need a new plugin-authored shadow fixture; v05-text-latin and v06-text-arabic have no committed fixture yet and also need the text render path. Authoring those fixtures and wiring the text render path is tracked by the parked issue #265; the v0.9 exit gate (#49) is where E7 flips from partial to met. No design source is fabricated or stood in for by the project's own render — that is the self-oracle failure G-11 forbids — so a pending frame's figmaFileKey, figmaNodeId, and designSource stay null and its status stays pending-265.

frames.note: Layout frame (E3 wrap; story #46). The committed fixture imports and renders to 420x184 and diffs within the aa-edge band against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:10. Hard rect edges — the aa-edge band.

Layout frame (E3 grid spans; story #46). The committed fixture imports and renders to 720x480 and diffs within the aa-edge band against Figma's GET /images render of node 1:11. The five structural cells (span/fill/minmax/fixed placement and positions) match the export pixel-exact — 0 differing pixels. The sixth cell diverges: its 'hug me' TEXT leaf solves to 0x0 because text measurement is not wired into the oracle render path, so the HUG cell hug-content collapses to its padding box (our 24x16 at x=452,y=124 vs Figma's 74x33). That single text-driven cell is excluded (excludeRegions is Figma's cell bbox, the superset covering every differing pixel) pending the text render-path follow-on (#265); with it excluded the frame measures 0 differing over the five structural cells. Hard rect edges — the aa-edge band.
